resources.string: Shows that the app is using the microphone and lets you stop or mute it.
The app is using the microphone
Capturing on this device. Nothing is sent to another machine yet.
Muted. The microphone stays open and no audio is sent.
Capture stopped because of an error.
Without microphone permission there is no capture. Grant it in the app settings and start again.
Notifications are turned off: capture can continue, but you will not see Stop or Mute in the status bar.
The microphone starts only while the app is visible.
Capture closed with a native error.
